field_text_formatted.value: Because the tokens only resolve once the entity is saved, every upload waits somewhere first. If that staging directory sits under public://, a file headed for a private field is in the web root until the save finishes. The module's been saying so on the status report since beta6 in December 2022, as a partial fix for SA-CONTRIB-2022-065:
